title: Founders sync (3 speakers, hand-off)

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: Retail partners want the device in stores by November. We need forty thousand units.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: The factory can do thirty thousand units in October if we lock the order this week.

segments.speaker: Carlos
segments.text: Cash wise we can cover the deposit, but I want the payment terms at net sixty.

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: Mei, can you negotiate net sixty with the factory?

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: Yes, I'll call them tomorrow morning.

segments.speaker: Carlos
segments.text: I'll update the cash forecast with the new order size.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: We should also redesign the packaging for retail shelves.

segments.speaker: Ravi
segments.text: Agreed, I'll brief the design agency on the packaging.

summary:
## Summary
- Ravi said retail partners want the device in stores by November.
- Carlos said the factory can do thirty thousand units in October.
- Mei suggested redesigning the packaging for retail shelves.
## Action items
- Ravi: negotiate net sixty with the factory.
- Carlos: update the cash forecast with the new order size.
- Mei: brief the design agency on the packaging.
- Carlos: book freight for the November shipment.
